description: The Eagle 5 was the Winnebago that Lone Starr and Barf traveled in, notably using it to rescue Princess Vespa.

trivia.text: While a life-sized Eagle 5 was used, the model was used for the scenes in which the Winnebago flew through space.
In 2017, the original 1/12th scale model of the Eagle 5 used in the filming of Spaceballs was put on auction.
